RACE.name: Race
RACE.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/RACE. A race carries a general stats struct, the models for each sex, the movement type names, the tint fieldsets and the biped object names. [measured: all 99 RACE records in Skyrim.esm are v44 and their DATA is 164 bytes]

ANAM.name: Skeletal Model
ANAM.note: The path to the male .nif. Some races, such as AlduinRace and SprigganSwarmRace, have no model at all.

ATKD.name: Attack Data
ATKD.note: The data for one mode of attack, 44 bytes, the same struct as NPC_'s.

ATKE.name: Attack Event
ATKE.note: The event name, which does not translate to an AACT or SMEN short name — for example "attackStart_Attack2".

ATKR.name: Attack Race
ATKR.note: The RACE to take the attack data from. Found in one record in Dawnguard.

BOD2.name: Body Template
BOD2.note: The body template, 8 bytes. The armor type is in BODT, which is 12 bytes.

DATA.name: General Race Stats
DATA.note: The race's skills, heights, weights, flags and stats.

DESC.name: Description
DESC.note: The description shown in the game when the player picks a race.

DNAM.name: Decapitate Armor
DNAM.note: The male and female decapitation armor (ARMO).

FNAM.name: Female Marker
FNAM.note: Zero-length; marks the start of the female model info.

FTSF.name: Face Details Texture Set List Female

FTSM.name: Face Details Texture Set List Male

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The full name shown in the game, an index into the string file.

GNAM.name: Body Part Data
GNAM.note: A BPTD record. It comes only after the second model.

HCLF.name: Default Hair Color
HCLF.note: The male and female hair color (CLFM).

INDX.name: Marker
INDX.note: Always zero. It precedes both egt models.

KWDA.name: Keyword
KWDA.note: The keywords. There is one per KSIZ, and KSIZ is a sibling subrecord rather than a count in the data, so the count comes from it.

LNAM.name: Close Loot Sound
LNAM.note: The sound (SNDR) played when the container is closed.

MNAM.name: Male Marker
MNAM.note: Zero-length; marks the start of the male model info.

MODL.name: Lighting Model
MODL.note: The path to the .egt. It seems to always use UpperBodyHumanMale and then UpperBodyHumanFemale, whatever the race.

MPAV.name: Unknown
MPAV.note: A 32-byte struct whose meaning is not documented.

MTNM.name: Movement Type Name
MTNM.note: A four-letter movement type code, such as WALK, RUN1, SNEK, BLD0 or SWIM. It is not NUL-terminated.

NAM0.name: Marker
NAM0.note: Zero-length; marks the start of the head data.

NAM1.name: Marker
NAM1.note: Zero-length; marks the start of the egt models.

NAM2.name: Marker
NAM2.note: Zero-length. The field has been removed and no longer exists.

NAM3.name: Marker
NAM3.note: Zero-length; marks the start of the hkx models.

NAM7.name: Decapitation FX
NAM7.note: The blood FX (ARTO), present only if the race can be decapitated.

NAME.name: Biped Object Name
NAME.note: A body part name as seen in BPTD. It appears exactly 32 times, and its order matches the biped object indices in DATA. The names are user-definable in the CK.

ONAM.name: Open Loot Sound
ONAM.note: The sound (SNDR) played when the container is opened.

PHTN.name: Phoneme Target Name
PHTN.note: The names of the phoneme targets, listed when used in PHWT. Dragons have different names from humanoids, and the names can also be listed in .tri files.

PHWT.name: Facial Expression Weight
PHWT.note: The weights for the points on the face. [measured: 172 of the PHWT fields in Skyrim.esm are 32 bytes, which is eight floats, and the rest are 64 bytes, which is sixteen; dragons have only eight and humanoids sixteen]

QNAM.name: Equip Slot
QNAM.note: The EQUP record for the race's equipment.

RPRF.name: Race Preset Female
RPRF.note: The female racial preset (NPC_). The CK applies the NPC_'s Is CharGen Face Preset flag to it.

SPCT.name: Spell Count
SPCT.note: How many SPLO records follow. Neither is present when the race has no bonus spells.

SPED.name: Override Values
SPED.note: The movement override's values: left, right, forward, back and rotate, each with a walk and a run, and one unknown.

SPLO.name: Spell
SPLO.note: A racial SPEL or SHOU. There is one per SPCT.

TINC.name: Preset
TINC.note: The preset, followed by a TINV.

TIND.name: Preset Default
TIND.note: The CLFM preset default. There is no TIND when no default is selected in the CK.

TINL.name: Tint Index Number
TINL.note: The total number of tints available to this race.

TINP.name: Mask Type
TINP.note: The mask's type: 1 = Lip Color, 2 = Cheek Color, 3 = Eyeliner, 4 = EyeSocket Upper, 5 = EyeSocket Lower, 6 = Skin Tone, 7 = Paint, 8 = Laugh Lines, 9 = Cheek Color Lower, 10 = Nose, 11 = Chin, 12 = Neck, 13 = Forehead, 14 = Dirt. There is no TINP when the mask type is none.

TINV.name: Default Value
TINV.note: The default value of the preceding TINC.

TIRS.name: Tint Number
TIRS.note: The number of the tint. The total number of tints is in TINL.

UNES.name: Unarmed Equip Slot
UNES.note: The EQUP record for the race's unarmed attacks.

VNAM.name: Equipment Type Flags
VNAM.note: The equipment types the race may use: hand to hand melee, one hand sword, one hand dagger, one hand axe, one hand mace, two hand sword, two hand axe, bow, staff, spell, shield, torch and crossbow. Other values are set but not used.

VTCK.name: Default Voice Types
VTCK.note: The male and female voice types (VTYP).
